$comment: Link targets for the printed references. The reference text is shown exactly as printed; only the link changes. A string replaces a printed address that does not resolve with the verified record for the same work (matched on title, first author and year at Crossref). null shows the reference unlinked because the printed address is dead and no record of the work was found. Checked 13 Oct 2026. Details: the correction note to the journal.

notes.https://www.medicaid.gov/federal-policy-: Not yet verified: the printed document can’t be found. Related CMS guidance doesn’t support the article’s broader funding claim, so it isn’t used in its place.
notes.https://doi.org/10.3390/buildings1304092: Not yet verified: the printed DOI leads to a different article, about building water disruptions. No matching paper has been confirmed.
notes.https://doi.org/10.1016/j.envres.2021.11: Not yet verified: the printed DOI leads to a different paper, about selective outcome reporting. A related Yao paper exists, but its authors, title and journal don’t match this citation, so it hasn’t been swapped in.
notes.https://doi.org/10.1016/j.envres.2022.11: Not yet verified: the printed DOI leads to a study of ultrafine particles and heart attacks. The cited Rony systematic review hasn’t been found; a related perspective piece is a different publication.
notes.https://doi.org/10.1002/hipo.22712: Not yet verified: the printed DOI leads to a mouse spatial-cognition study, not the cited Bohbot wayfinding paper. No matching paper has been confirmed.
notes.https://doi.org/10.1016/j.conbuildmat.20: Not yet verified: the printed DOI leads to a metakaolin geopolymer study, not the cited Peñaloza review of timber life cycles. No matching paper has been confirmed.
Corrected destination: Bartesaghi Koc, Osmond and Peters, Evaluating the cooling effects of green infrastructure: A systematic review of methods, indicators and data sources, Solar Energy (2018). The printed author list and journal differ.
notes.https://doi.org/10.1186/s41018-022-00123: Citation note: this identifier points to Conzatti, Kershaw, Copping and Coley, A review of the impact of shelter design on the health of displaced populations. The printed authors and title differ.
notes.https://doi.org/10.3390/buildings1508128: Citation note: this identifier points to Al-Homoud and Samarah, Redesigning Refuge: Spatial Adaptations and Defensible Space Principles in Zaatari Camp in Jordan. The printed authors and title differ.
notes.https://doi.org/10.3390/su16209127: Citation note: this identifier points to Al-Shoubaki and colleagues, A Human-Centered Shelter Design for People on the Move in the Al-Sahel Region. The printed authors and title differ.
notes.https://doi.org/10.3390/ijerph20095637: Citation note: the indexed title is Architectural Allostatic Overloading: Exploring a Connection between Architectural Form and Allostatic Overloading, by Valentine.
notes.https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/article: Bibliographic note: this record is by Rebecca L Ames and Janet E Loebach, Applying Trauma-Informed Design Principles to Therapeutic Residential Care Facilities to Reduce Retraumatization and Promote Resiliency Among Youth in Care, Journal of Child & Adolescent Trauma (2023). The printed authors, title and journal differ.
notes.https://doi.org/10.3389/fbuil.2024.14676: Citation note: the authors are Al Khatib I, Samara F and Ndiaye M; the printed initials differ.
Citation note: the indexed subtitle is Please don’t make me sit in the middle, not Passenger reactions.
notes.https://doi.org/10.1016/j.susmat.2015.05: Bibliographic note: the indexed publication year is 2015, rather than the printed 2017.
notes.https://doi.org/10.1021/es403688w: Citation note: the paper’s indexed title is Longitudinal effects on mental health of moving to greener and less green urban areas. The printed title paraphrases it.
notes.https://journals.ed.ac.uk/ear/article/vi: The printed address identifies Emma van Daal’s Entanglement of trauma spaces, published 29 January 2024 in an issue dated 2023. It is not the cited Shepley and Sachs neighborhood-trauma review. The intended work has not been verified; preserve the printed reference as historical text and do not silently relabel it.
notes.6. Justus, C., & Raghani, M. (2025). Tra: Verified work: Joanne Justus and Smruti Raghani, Trauma-informed design: shelter homes for runaway children, International Journal of Adolescence and Youth 30(1), article 2445053 (2025; online 29 December 2024), DOI 10.1080/02673843.2024.2445053. Printed initials, issue and page range differ.
notes.https://doi.org/10.3390/buildings1407077: Corrected citation: the paper is by Cleo Valentine, Tony Steffert, Heather Mitcheltree and Koen Steemers, Buildings 14(5), 1292. The printed authors, volume, issue and article number differ. Its abstract reports no statistically significant change in relative alpha.
notes.https://doi.org/10.1177/1937586710004002: The verified Golembiewski work appears in Facilities 28(3/4),100–117 (2010), not the printed HERD journal/volume/pages.
